name: ArcRoute AI - Intelligent Customer Request Triage

nodes.name: Webhook - Receive Request
nodes.notes: Receives customer requests from email, web forms, or support portals. Configure webhook auth in n8n or validate a shared token before production use.

nodes.name: Normalize Input
nodes.notes: Normalizes webhook payloads and generates request_id/received_at when absent.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: $json.model_name, temperature: 0.1, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: `You are ArcRoute AI, an intake classifier for ArcVault customer requests. Return valid JSON only. Do not include markdown, comments, prose, or code fences. Classify based on primary intent. Use semantic understanding for classification and enrichment only. Do not choose destination queues, do not decide human escalation, and do not apply deterministic routing rules. Valid categories: Bug Report, Feature Request, Billing Issue, Technical Question, Incident/Outage. Valid priorities: Low, Medium, High. Low means informational or non-blocking. Medium means a specific user/workflow is blocked or money is involved without widespread outage. High means service unavailable, multiple users affected, production workflows blocked, security/access risk, or strong urgency/outage language. Confidence score must be an integer 0-100 based on evidence. Do not invent facts. Use null, {}, or [] when unavailable. Return exactly: {"category":"Bug Report | Feature Request | Billing Issue | Technical Question | Incident/Outage","priority":"Low | Medium | High","confidence_score":0,"core_issue":"One concise sentence.","identifiers":{"account_reference":null,"invoice_number":null,"error_code":null,"amounts":[],"time_references":[],"authentication_provider":null,"affected_users":null},"urgency_signal":"None | Low | Medium | High","urgency_reason":"Short explanation based only on the message.","customer_impact":"Concise impact description.","requires_follow_up_information":true,"missing_information":[],"human_readable_summary":"Two or three concise sentences."}` }, { role: 'user', content: `Source: ${$json.source}\nReceived at: ${$json.received_at}\nMessage: ${$json.raw_message}` } ] } }}

nodes.name: LLM - Classify and Enrich

httpHeaderAuth.name: Groq API Header Auth - set Authorization Bearer token

nodes.notes: Calls Groq with temperature near zero. Configure HTTP Header Auth with Authorization: Bearer {{$env.GROQ_API_KEY}} or your n8n credential equivalent.

nodes.name: Parse and Validate JSON
nodes.notes: Validates the strict JSON response. Invalid output continues as a low-confidence fallback and is escalated.

nodes.name: IF - LLM Output Valid
nodes.notes: Routes valid LLM output forward. Invalid output receives one automatic retry.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: $('Normalize Input').first().json.model_name, temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'Return valid JSON only using the exact ArcRoute schema. Do not include markdown or prose. Use only facts present in the customer message.' }, { role: 'user', content: `Previous output failed validation: ${JSON.stringify($json.validation_errors || [])}\nCustomer message: ${$('Normalize Input').first().json.raw_message}` } ] } }}

nodes.name: Retry Invalid LLM Output

httpHeaderAuth.name: Groq API Header Auth - set Authorization Bearer token

nodes.notes: Makes one retry when the first LLM response is malformed or schema-invalid.

nodes.name: Parse Retry JSON
nodes.notes: Validates the retry. Repeated failure becomes a fallback Human Review record.

nodes.name: Calculate Billing Difference
nodes.notes: Calculates billing discrepancy deterministically when both billed and expected amounts are available.

nodes.name: Determine Recommended Queue
nodes.notes: Applies deterministic queue mapping. The LLM does not choose queues.

nodes.name: Evaluate Escalation Rules
nodes.notes: Applies auditable escalation rules outside the LLM.

nodes.name: Set Final Queue
nodes.notes: Preserves recommended_queue and overrides final_queue only for escalated records.

parameters.jsCode:
const r = { ...$json };
r.processed_at = new Date().toISOString();
const finalRecord = {
  request_id: r.request_id,
  source: r.source,
  received_at: r.received_at,
  raw_message: r.raw_message,
  category: r.category,
  priority: r.priority,
  confidence_score: r.confidence_score,
  core_issue: r.core_issue,
  identifiers: r.identifiers,
  urgency_signal: r.urgency_signal,
  urgency_reason: r.urgency_reason,
  customer_impact: r.customer_impact,
  requires_follow_up_information: r.requires_follow_up_information,
  missing_information: r.missing_information,
  recommended_queue: r.recommended_queue,
  final_queue: r.final_queue,
  escalation_flag: r.escalation_flag,
  escalation_reasons: r.escalation_reasons,
  human_readable_summary: r.human_readable_summary,
  model_name: r.model_name,
  workflow_version: r.workflow_version,
  processed_at: r.processed_at
};
return [{ json: { ...finalRecord, sheet_row: { 'Request ID': finalRecord.request_id, 'Source': finalRecord.source, 'Raw message': finalRecord.raw_message, 'Category': finalRecord.category, 'Priority': finalRecord.priority, 'Confidence': finalRecord.confidence_score, 'Core issue': finalRecord.core_issue, 'Identifiers': JSON.stringify(finalRecord.identifiers), 'Urgency': finalRecord.urgency_signal, 'Recommended queue': finalRecord.recommended_queue, 'Final queue': finalRecord.final_queue, 'Escalation flag': finalRecord.escalation_flag, 'Escalation reasons': JSON.stringify(finalRecord.escalation_reasons), 'Summary': finalRecord.human_readable_summary, 'Processed timestamp': finalRecord.processed_at } } }];

nodes.name: Create Final Record
nodes.notes: Creates the final output schema and a flattened row for Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Store All Records
nodes.notes: Stores every processed request. Map sheet_row fields to the documented columns if auto-map is unavailable in your n8n version.

nodes.name: IF - Escalated
nodes.notes: Splits escalated records to the Human Review Queue sheet.

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Escalation Queue
nodes.notes: Stores only records where escalation_flag is true.

nodes.name: Webhook Response
nodes.notes: Returns the completed final JSON record to the caller.

meta.notes: Credential IDs and Google Sheets document ID must be configured manually in n8n. Do not commit real secrets.
